name: Direform Regal (Deflect 4)

features.Martial Experience: The direform can use their Strike action twice on their turn.
features.Obstinate Guard: It costs the direform 1 fewer focus to resist an enemy’s influence.
features.Spiked Carapace: The direform can use their carapace like a shield (Brace action). While benefiting from Brace, the first time on each turn the direform is hit or grazed by a melee attack or is successfully Grappled or Shoved, that enemy takes 3 (1d6) keen damage.

action.name: Strike: Hammer
action.description: Attack +8, reach 5 ft., one target. Gains advantage if they moved at least 10 ft in a straight line toward the target this turn. Graze: 5 (1d10) impact damage. Hit: 13 (1d10 + 8) impact damage.

action.name: Strike: Longbow
action.description: Attack +8, range 150/600 ft., one target. Graze: 3 (1d6) keen damage. Hit: 11 (1d6 + 8) keen damage.

action.name: Invested Enhancement
action.description: Costs 1 Investiture. The direform becomes Enhanced [Strength +1] and Enhanced [Speed +1] until end of next turn (all Physical skills +1). At end of each turn, can spend 1 Investiture to maintain one additional round.

reaction.name: Stand Firm
reaction.description: Costs 1 Focus. Before the direform is unwillingly moved or knocked Prone, they ignore that effect.

reaction.name: Tackle
reaction.description: When an enemy triggers a Reactive Strike from the direform, the direform can attempt to Grapple instead, spending focus as if making Reactive Strike. On success, target takes 3 (1d6) keen damage from spikes and is grappled.

tactics: Direct combatant. Uses Longbow until enemies close, then closes distance to Hammer with Invested Enhancement, mixing in Brace and Tackle to stop foes fleeing.
